svg.title: Runtime workload protocol
svg.desc: The verifier reads pending/history from tasks and scheduler/connection counters from runtime; those are distinct response shapes. The first retained campaign exposed this verifier mistake after its semantic actions, and a separate corrected 1/4/8/16/32 diagnostic verifies all bounds. Observation metadata reconstruction retains each transport’s requested-baseline state, inherits omitted keys only in delta mode, overlays emitted values, then requires all six metadata fields to match the independently forced-full result. Full/reset responses cannot inherit. Raw response payloads and token denominators are unchanged by these verifier corrections.
